en.sayed-ali-raza: Where are the minds which seek light from the lamps of guidance, and the eyes which look at minarets of piety?
Where are the hearts dedicated to Allāh, and devoted to the obedience of Allāh?
They are all crowding towards worldly vanities and quarrelling over unlawful issues.
The ensigns of Paradise and Hell have been raised for them but they have turned their faces away from Paradise and proceeded to Hell by dint of their performances.
Allāh called them but they showed dislike and ran away. When Satan called them they responded and proceeded (towards him).
